name: sc-b-running
caption: A running step. The head names it and says running once. The bar holds Agent, Logs and Changes, with a red Stop on the right. Four tiles: 16d 16h elapsed, the same as its node in the graph, attempt 1 of the 3 allowed, a dash for cost (its tooltip says cost comes when the attempt ends), and 182k tokens. A striped bar runs from Oct 19 11:41 to now. Nothing else is drawn under the card, and the Needs-you box says only 'Nothing found'.

name: sc-b-finished
caption: A finished step that opened a pull request. The bar adds a count of 7 on Changes and a PR #3251 button, and has no Stop. The tiles show 5m 03s, attempt 1 of 3, $0.42 and 1.2M tokens, over a green bar from 11:36 to 11:41. Nothing under the card repeats the state or contradicts the pull request.

name: sc-b-failed
caption: A failed step on its third and last attempt. A blue Retry sits on the right of the bar. The error, in the agent's own words, is in a red-edged block cut to three lines with a Show all button, and that is the only place it appears: the Needs-you row for this step keeps its name, Retry and Open but not the error. The tiles read 59s and attempt 3 of 3, the same as the node, and the bar shows three failed attempts with the third ringed.

name: sc-b-parked
caption: A parked step that was never attempted. The bar has only Agent. One line says it waits on scan-terraform; the head's up arrow is the way there, so the card has no second button for it. No tiles, timeline or Details, and no attempt or checkpoint is shown anywhere in the inspector.

name: sc-b-attempts
caption: A step with three attempts, with attempt 2 selected. The three segments differ in width by how long each ran (1m 05s, 5m 02s, 2m 10s), two failed and one succeeded, and the times under the bar, 11:33 to 11:38, are attempt 2's own. The tiles show attempt 2 of 3; its cost and tokens were not reported, so both are dashes with tooltips. Details is open with exit code 1 and 1 checkpoint, and it is the only thing called Details in the inspector.

name: sc-b-running-1280
caption: The running step at 1280x800. The four tiles stay on one row and the bar on one line, with Stop on the right.

name: sc-b-finished-390
caption: The finished step on a 390px phone, in the bottom sheet. The back control is a bordered Workflow button. Agent, Logs, Changes and PR #3251 share one row, and the tiles go two by two. The sheet ends at the card's Details fold.
